DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Crcy"}, 's_ReportLines'[Display Unit])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"Contoso Holding NV"}, 'd_Company'[Company Name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"K"}, 's Scale'[Scale])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		TREATAS({"Statutory P&L"}, 's_ReportLines'[Report Name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable5 = 
		TREATAS({"'d_Profit Center'[PC code]"}, 'sf Slot B (Filters)'[sf Slot B Fields])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable6 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'd_Currency_Report'[Is Default])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable7 = 
		TREATAS({"ACTUAL PY"}, 's_Scenario Comparable_Filter'[Version])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable8 = 
		TREATAS({"Reported"}, 's_PL_Currency_View'[View])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable9 = 
		TREATAS({"0"}, 's Decimal'[Decimal])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable10 = 
		TREATAS({"0.00%"}, 's DecimalPct'[Format])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable11 = 
		TREATAS({"ACTUAL"}, 'd_Scenario'[Version])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable12 = 
		TREATAS({"'d_CostCenter'[Cost Center Full]"}, 'sf Slot A (Filters)'[sf Slot A Fields])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable13 = 
		TREATAS({"Contoso Holding Group"}, 'd_Enterprise'[Enterprise Name])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable14 = 
		TREATAS({"YTD"}, 's_TimeCalc'[Selection])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable15 = 
		TREATAS({"Calendar"}, 's_Switch_Calendar_Fiscal'[Selection])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable16 = 
		TREATAS({"X"}, 's_ReportLines'[Is Top Level])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable17 = 
		TREATAS({"Comp. Curr"}, 's_Currency_Doc vs Company'[Abbreviation])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable18 = 
		TREATAS({"OCT 25"}, 's_Period'[Month Year (MMMYY) (inversed sort)])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable19 = 
		TREATAS(
			{("Header", "'d_CostCenter'[Cost Center Full]"),
				("Header", "'d_Profit Center'[PC code]"),
				("Header", "'d_Company'[Company Code|Name]")},
			'sf Filter 2'[Category],
			'sf Filter 2'[sf Filter 2 Fields]
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable20 = 
		TREATAS(
			{("General", "'d_GL Account'[GL Account Full]"),
				("General", "'d_Relation'[Relation Full]"),
				("General", "'d_Vendor'[VendorName]"),
				("Header", "'d_CostCenter'[Cost Center Full]")},
			'sf Filter 1'[Category],
			'sf Filter 1'[sf Filter 1 Fields]
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent)],
			's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent) Sort],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__DS0FilterTable2,
			__DS0FilterTable3,
			__DS0FilterTable4,
			__DS0FilterTable5,
			__DS0FilterTable6,
			__DS0FilterTable7,
			__DS0FilterTable8,
			__DS0FilterTable9,
			__DS0FilterTable10,
			__DS0FilterTable11,
			__DS0FilterTable12,
			__DS0FilterTable13,
			__DS0FilterTable14,
			__DS0FilterTable15,
			__DS0FilterTable16,
			__DS0FilterTable17,
			__DS0FilterTable18,
			__DS0FilterTable19,
			__DS0FilterTable20,
			"PL___TC0_Reported", 'm_Measures'[PL | TC0 Reported],
			"v_PL___TC0_Reported_FormatString", IGNORE('m_Measures'[_PL | TC0 Reported FormatString]),
			"PL_____of_Revenue", 'm_Measures'[PL | % of Revenue],
			"FMT___Var_Bar_SVG", 'm_Measures'[FMT | Var Bar SVG],
			"LBL___FS_Variance_Signed", 'm_Measures'[LBL | FS Variance Signed],
			"LBL___FS_Variance_Pct_Signed", 'm_Measures'[LBL | FS Variance Pct Signed],
			"FMT___Variance_Sign_Color", IGNORE('m_Measures'[FMT | Variance Sign Color])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			501,
			__DS0Core,
			's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent) Sort],
			1,
			's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent)],
			1
		)

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		__DS0FilterTable2,
		__DS0FilterTable3,
		__DS0FilterTable4,
		__DS0FilterTable5,
		__DS0FilterTable6,
		__DS0FilterTable7,
		__DS0FilterTable8,
		__DS0FilterTable9,
		__DS0FilterTable10,
		__DS0FilterTable11,
		__DS0FilterTable12,
		__DS0FilterTable13,
		__DS0FilterTable14,
		__DS0FilterTable15,
		__DS0FilterTable16,
		__DS0FilterTable17,
		__DS0FilterTable18,
		__DS0FilterTable19,
		__DS0FilterTable20,
		"LBL___PLS_Title_Moved", IGNORE('m_Measures'[LBL | PLS Title Moved])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent) Sort], 's_ReportLines'[Line Name (Indent)]
